blocks.body:
- **Kanezaka**, nestled beside Hanamura, is our newest Free-For-All Map!
- Fight for your life in a thrilling battlefield of alleyways, ancient
stone, towering steel, and cat cafes. Shatter your enemy's dreams in
the pottery shop, deliver beatdowns in the Tora no Sumika nightclub,
or rise above the competition in the tower at the center of the city.

Celebrate the release of Overwatch’s newest map with the Kanezaka Challenge! Through January 25, earn limited-time rewards, including the new Kyōgisha Hanzo skin, by winning games and watching Overwatch on Twitch.

Learn more about the Kanezaka Challenge on the Overwatch website.

blocks.title: Feature Update: Replay Viewer Custom Spectator Options
blocks.body: - Added Detached Timecode UI option to Replay Viewer

heroes.dev_note: Ashe being able to eliminate 200 health enemy heroes with one headshot while assisted by 30% damage boost became too dominant, especially when combined with the other improvements to her weapon. We are lowering the maximum damage but also the shot recovery time to keep her overall damage output relatively the same.

changes.text_en: Aim-down-sights recovery time reduced from 0.7 to 0.65 seconds

heroes.dev_note: This rate of fire change improves the feel and effectiveness of the Storm Arrows ability and though small, adds up over the course of firing 5 arrows.

changes.text_en: Shot recovery time reduced from 0.3 to 0.25 seconds

heroes.dev_note: We're increasing the cooldown of Sigma's barrier to require a higher commitment to its placement and open up additional opportunities for counterplay.

changes.text_en: Redeploy cooldown increased from 1 to 2.5 seconds

heroes.dev_note: Wrecking Ball's high mobility and potential for massive shield health have left him a bit too survivable after the overall damage and crowd control in the game have been tuned down. We are reducing the amount of additional shields he generates per target though the base 100 shields from the ability remains unchanged.

changes.text_en: Shield per target reduced from 100 to 75

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that caused the flex role rewards banner to not display immediately
- Fixed a bug with the end of round screen for Deathmatch that would
exclude players who left when the match ends
- Fixed a bug that caused achievement categories in the career profile to become misaligned when setting the filter to "locked"
- Fixed a bug that caused jump landing sounds to not playback properly
- Fixed a bug with long spray names overlapping with UI elements
- [Fixed on impacted platforms] Fixed a bug that caused an indefinite
loading icon on the Social menu if your friends list is empty
- [PC-Only] Fixed a bug that caused the mouse cursor to remain focused on the game client while in windowed or windowed fullscreen mode
